edit_summary: Attempt-2 round-1 remediation: both reviewers independently found the same Major -- the no-orphan assertion was added to the PowerShell (a) sub-case only, while POSIX's kill -TERM <pid> reaches a single process and would leave a vendor-CLI grandchild orphaned holding the API session (Edge Case 2), with no test catching it. The AC-004 POSIX row now commits to process-group semantics (setsid on start, kill -TERM -<pgid> on expiry) and carries the same no-orphan assertion; the TEST-004 sub-case table marks (a) as including it in both runtimes; design.md's _sdd_run_bounded helper now starts the child under setsid and signals the negative pid with a bare-pid fallback. Rationale recorded: BL-004 parity is an OUTCOME claim, and 'no orphan holding the API session' is an outcome, so it cannot hold if only one runtime is required to deliver it.
